title: Environment Zones & Overlays
selected_by_owner: Owner directed the next standalone MMHT cycle.

in_scope: Draw and redraw independent environment polygons or attach a zone to existing map geometry, a level or the whole map
Assign catalog-backed presets and explicit overlays, show labels, independently toggle layers and flag source-defined conflicts within one zone
Preserve stable zone IDs, saved scope, overlay references and GM/player-filtered handoff data
boundaries: Owner-approved map authoring only. Ship and vehicle operations, base construction, farming, extraction, ecology simulation and other gameplay engines retain their owner-domain scope. Map features may store typed references for later integration.
Standalone artifact confirmation is separate from installed product integration and owner playtest feedback.

evidence.validation: Executed the generated HTML in JSDOM with native Canvas. Verified 81 preset/reference choices and 47 overlays, draw and redraw with stable IDs, undo/redo, map picking, saved layer visibility and scope, GM-only export filtering, same-zone conflict messages, and retained utility and interior map references. The strict TypeScript check reports the existing MCS-03 operationId narrowing error.
evidence.example: Harrowfen Reach shows drawn marsh and fog zones over illustrated terrain. Brinegate demonstrates a level-wide cave preset and a low-oxygen cistern pocket. Meridian shows a whole-map station baseline, a transfer lock and a localized vacuum overlay.
evidence.boundaries: Authored map references and display precedence. ENV retains composition and runtime mechanics authority. Physical Android testing remains pending.

next_action: Review the environment survey examples and zone editing in the HTML. Use feedback for Water, Weather & Hazard Layers when MMHT-06 is selected.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-05 offline HTML, artifact checksum and executed environment workflow checks.

stop_reason.evidence: Environment scope, overlay authoring and filtered map exports were saved and passed focused standalone verification.
